process.title: A traceable process from first contact to handover.
process.intro: A clear process protects time, budget and sensitive information. Every engagement starts with assessment and scope, not premature promises.

steps.title: Initial contact
steps.text: Send the objective, current situation and urgency by WhatsApp, Viber or email – never passwords or confidential access details.

steps.title: Assessment & scope
steps.text: We clarify causes, systems, target market, stakeholders and risks, then provide a candid view of feasibility and scope.

steps.title: Delivery & communication
steps.text: We work in agreed steps, confirm decisions and flag deviations early rather than hiding them.

steps.title: Handover & continuation
steps.text: You receive results, relevant documentation, open items and a prioritised recommendation for the secure next step.

assurance.title: What you can expect – and what you cannot.
assurance.text: Good cooperation starts with realistic expectations. BIT works independently, discreetly and with defined accountability. We never request credentials through messaging apps.
items: No vendor commission drives our recommendation
No guarantee of market success, contracts or flawless third-party systems
Confidential access only through an agreed secure channel
MFA, minimum permissions and documented changes as standard
External specialists only when needed and with a defined scope
Costs, assumptions and unresolved risks stated before implementation

items.question: Which businesses do you support in Zurich?
items.answer: We primarily support SMEs, medical practices, trades and service firms, hotels and restaurants. Each engagement is scoped according to the systems, urgency and specialist expertise required.

items.question: Are hotels and restaurants separate services?
items.answer: No. They remain one hospitality service point because PMS, OTA, POS, payments, Wi-Fi and operational processes are often interdependent.

items.question: What does PMS/OTA reconciliation include?
items.answer: Depending on scope, we review rates, availability, booking flows, mapping, folios, fees, commissions and unusual variances. BIT is independent and is not an official PMS vendor representative.

items.question: How do you support Swiss market entry?
items.answer: We validate target segments and positioning, qualify contacts, conduct agreed outreach, support meetings and coordinate pilots. Activity, feedback and conclusions are documented.

items.question: Do you guarantee customers or sales in Switzerland?
items.answer: No. Responsible business development cannot guarantee contracts. We provide structured validation, local activity and reliable feedback so you can make evidence-based investment decisions.

items.question: Do you work remotely or on site?
items.answer: Many assessments and support tasks can be delivered remotely. On-site work in Zurich and elsewhere in Switzerland is arranged according to availability and a clear scope.

items.question: How do we start?
items.answer: Send a short outline through WhatsApp, Viber or email, including your objective, current situation and urgency. Never send passwords, access codes or sensitive customer data through messaging apps.

items.question: Can BIT provide ongoing support or representation?
items.answer: Yes, where systems, responsibilities, territory and response expectations are clearly defined. We normally begin with an assessment before agreeing an ongoing mandate.

about.title: Personally managed. Professionally connected.

privacy_detail.intro: This website provides an inquiry form for needs assessment. When you submit the form, the details you enter are processed so BIT can assess your needs and contact you. Alternatively, you can reach BIT by email, phone or WhatsApp.
categories: Microsoft 365 status and internal/external IT situation (optional)
Technical transmission metadata (e.g. timestamp, request ID; possibly IP country via the hosting provider)
privacy_detail.purpose: Needs assessment: reviewing whether and on what basis collaboration is possible, and contacting you with an initial assessment.
privacy_detail.basis: Consent. You give it via the mandatory checkbox on the inquiry form before submitting.
privacy_detail.retention: Inquiries are stored for a maximum of twelve months and then deleted, unless statutory retention duties or legitimate grounds require longer storage.
privacy_detail.processors: Details from the inquiry form are delivered to admin@boksitsupport.ch and stored for needs assessment. In addition, an operator-configured short messaging notification (for example Telegram or Slack) may be triggered so the inquiry is seen promptly. Optionally, an email notification may be sent via an email delivery service (Resend). Website hosting: Cloudflare Pages. Cloudflare and, if used, Resend or the chosen messaging service may operate servers outside Switzerland.
privacy_detail.abroad: Depending on the delivery path (messaging notification if enabled, email delivery service if enabled) and hosting (Cloudflare), processing or storage may take place outside Switzerland or the EEA. WhatsApp may process contact, device and communication metadata outside Switzerland if you use that channel.
privacy_detail.rights: You may request access to, rectification or deletion of your personal data and withdraw consent for the future. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before withdrawal.
privacy_detail.contact: For privacy requests: admin@boksitsupport.ch. Do not send passwords, recovery codes or specially protected personal data through the form or messaging apps.
privacy_detail.no_tracking: There is no invasive tracking and no advertising measurement. When you visit the site, the hosting provider may process technically necessary server logs.
